sources.note: Nothing; Glottolog lists zero descriptive (grammar/sketch/phonology/wordlist-tagged) works for Nindi. The only bib entries whose language code field includes 'Nindi [nxi]' in the local sources.bib are von Behr 1893 (ethnographic overview), Booth 1905 (ethnographic;wordlist) and Maho & Sands 2002-2004 (bibliographical). Ebner 1987 is cited only for subclassification (p. 49) and its language code does not list Nindi.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Ethnographic history of the Ngoni; p. 224-225 gives 'eine Liste von 55 gebräuchlichen Wörtern in Kingoni und Kissutu des Bischofs Spiss, sowie in Kidendauli, Kinindi und Kinyassa' — a bare comparative wordlist with a Kinindi column, no accent marks (0 accented vowels in the scanned of the table), no remarks on Betonung/Akzent. Says only that 'Kingindo, Kinindi und der Ost-Nyassadialekte' are very similar (p. 224).
